caption: The drawing features a ceramic bowl depicted in three views on a light beige background. The main central view shows the bowl from a slightly elevated angle, emphasizing its wide opening and shallow depth. The bowl is colored in shades of brown and terracotta, with a glossy appearance and decorative wavy lines in yellow and light brown encircling the inner surface near the rim. In the bottom left corner, the bowl is viewed from directly above, showcasing the concentric decorative wavy lines that cover the interior. In the top right corner, a small rectangular inset contains a simple side profile of the bowl, illustrating its flared rim and gently sloping sides. Each view is outlined with fine lines, and all components are rendered in a realistic and precise manner to clearly describe the bowl's shape, proportions, and decoration.
title: Bowl
